title: Window settings that persist
description:
Save each tool window's position, size and open state, and restore them on start.

```
saved: Inspector (20, 40, 300x500, open), Log (340, 40, 600x200, closed)
restore with a smaller screen 1280x720: Log moved back on screen
unknown window "Old" in the file: kept for later
```
hints: `<sstream>` gives streams over strings. `std::istringstream in{ text };` reads from a string exactly like `std::cin` (`in >> word >> number`, or `std::getline(in, line)` for one line at a time), and its condition is false once a read fails. `std::ostringstream out; out << "x " << 5; out.str()` builds a string the way `std::cout` prints.
Clamp `x` to `0 .. screenW - min(w, screenW)` and the same for `y` (lesson 14.05).
Dear ImGui's own `.ini` does this for its windows; this is the same idea for your tool's own settings.
requirements: A text format with one line per window.
On restore, move windows that would be off the current screen back inside it.
Lines you do not recognise are kept and written back.
stretch: Save one layout per monitor setup.
